function.name: kinematics__calculate_displacement
function.description: Calculate displacement based on initial speed, acceleration, and time interval for a motion along a straight line.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the moving object in m/s.

acceleration.description: The rate of change of speed, m/s^2.

time.description: The time interval during which the acceleration is applied, in seconds.

rounding.description: The number of decimals to round off the result (optional).

function.name: kinematics__calculate_final_speed
function.description: Calculate the final speed of an object that starts from an initial speed and then accelerates for a certain duration.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the moving object in m/s.

acceleration.description: The rate of change of speed, m/s^2.

time.description: The time interval during which the acceleration is applied, in seconds.

rounding.description: The number of decimals to round off the result (optional).

function.name: kinematics__calculate_acceleration
function.description: Calculates the acceleration of an object under given conditions.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object.

final_speed.description: The final speed of the object.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to reach the final speed.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled.

function.name: kinematics__calculate_speed_from_rest
function.description: Calculates the speed of an object that starts from rest under a constant acceleration over a specified distance.

distance.description: The distance in meters the object has traveled.

time.description: The time in seconds it took the object to travel.

initial_speed.description: The initial speed of the object.

function.name: capacitance_calculator__calculate
function.description: Calculate the capacitance of a parallel plate capacitor based on the area, distance and dielectric constant using the equation C = ε₀KA/d.

A.description: The area of one plate of the capacitor in square meters.

d.description: The distance between the two plates in meters.

K.description: The dielectric constant (default is 1.0 for free space, optional).

function.name: resistance_calculator__calculate
function.description: Calculate the resistance of an electrical circuit based on current and voltage.

I.description: The electric current flowing in Amperes.

function.name: magnetic_field__calculate
function.description: Calculate the magnetic field based on the current flowing and the radial distance.

I.description: The electric current flowing in Amperes.

r.description: The radial distance from the line of current in meters.

function.name: electric_field__calculate
function.description: Calculate the electric field based on the amount of charge and distance from the charge

Q.description: The amount of charge in coulombs.

r.description: The distance from the charge in meters.

function.name: country_info__capital
function.description: Fetch the capital city of a specified country.

function.name: country_info__largest_city
function.description: Fetch the largest city of a specified country.

function.name: country_info__population
function.description: Fetch the current population of a specified country.

function.name: maps__get_distance_duration
function.description: Retrieve the travel distance and estimated travel time from one location to another via car

traffic.description: If true, considers current traffic. Default is false.

function.name: weather__get
function.description: Get the current weather details such as temperature, wind speed, and precipitation for a specified city and country.

city.description: The name of the city for which the weather is being requested, such as 'San Francisco'.

country.description: The country where the city is located, in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code format, such as 'US' for the United States.

units.description: The unit system for the temperature: 'metric' for Celsius, 'imperial' for Fahrenheit. Defaults to 'metric'.

include_forecast.description: A flag to indicate whether to include a weather forecast for the next 5 days. Defaults to false.

function.name: weather__get_forecast_by_coordinates
function.description: Get the weather forecast for a specific geographical coordinates.

coordinates.description: The geographical coordinates for which to retrieve the weather. The first element of the tuple is the latitude and the second is the longitude.

days_ahead.description: Number of days to forecast from current date (optional, default is 7).

function.name: weather__get_by_coordinates_date
function.description: Retrieves the historical weather data based on coordinates and date.

coordinates.description: The geographical coordinates for which to retrieve the weather. The first element of the tuple is the latitude and the second is the longitude.

date.description: The date for which to retrieve the historical weather data in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

function.name: weather__humidity_forecast
function.description: Retrieve a humidity forecast for a specific location and time frame.

location.description: The city that you want to get the humidity for.

days.description: Number of days for the forecast.

min_humidity.description: Minimum level of humidity (in percentage) to filter the result. Optional parameter. Default is 0.

function.name: corporate_finance__calculate_YOY_growth_rate
function.description: Calculate the year over year (YOY) growth rate for a company.

company_name.description: The name of the company for which to calculate the YOY growth rate.

year1_revenue.description: The revenue for the initial year.

year2_revenue.description: The revenue for the subsequent year.

function.name: corporate_finance__product_price
function.description: Fetch the current selling price of the product.

company.description: The company that sells the product.

product.description: The product whose price we want to fetch.

function.name: corporate_finance__revenue_forecast
function.description: Estimate the revenue of a company by multiplying the sales units of the product with its selling price.

company.description: The company that you want to calculate the revenue for.

product.description: The product sold by the company.

sales_units_increase_percentage.description: Percentage increase in the sales units. This value is optional and defaults to zero if not provided.

function.name: corporate_finance__dividend_data
function.description: Get historical dividend data of a specific company within a particular duration.

company.description: The company that you want to get the dividend data for.

years.description: Number of past years for which to retrieve the data.

frequency.description: The frequency of the dividend payment. Default annually

function.name: finance__loan_repayment
function.description: Calculates the monthly repayment for a loan.

loan_term.description: The term of the loan in years.

function.name: finance__inflation_adjustment
function.description: Adjusts a sum of money for inflation based on the consumer price index (CPI).

years.description: The number of years over which inflation is calculated.

inflation_rate.description: The annual rate of inflation. Default 0.0

function.name: finance__calculate_future_value
function.description: Calculate the future value of an investment given an initial investment, annual rate of return, and a time frame.

years.description: The time frame of the investment in years.

contribution.description: Optional: Additional regular contributions. Default is 0.

function.name: currency_conversion__convert
function.description: Converts a specified amount of money from one currency to another at the latest rate.

from_currency.description: The currency that you want to convert from.

to_currency.description: The currency that you want to convert to.

amount.description: The amount of money that you want to convert.

function.name: realestate__find_properties
function.description: Find properties based on location, budget, and specifications

location.description: City and state where the property is located, e.g. San Diego, CA.

propertyType.description: Type of property such as villa, condo, apartment, etc.

bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms required in the property.

function.name: property_valuation__get
function.description: Get estimated value of a property based on location, specifications and age

location.description: City and state where the property is located, e.g. San Diego, CA.

propertyType.description: Type of property such as villa, condo, apartment, etc.

bedrooms.description: Number of bedrooms required in the property.

age.description: Age of the property in years.

function.name: finance__property_depreciation
function.description: Calculates the depreciated value of a property given its initial cost, depreciation rate, and the number of years.

initial_cost.description: The initial cost of the property.

depreciation_rate.description: The annual depreciation rate in percentage.

years.description: The number of years for which to calculate the depreciation.

monthly.description: If set to true, it will calculate monthly depreciation instead of annually. (optional)

function.name: car_rental
function.description: Rent a car near you based on your preference.

car_type.description: Type of cars that you want to rent.

fuel_type.description: Preferred fuel type of car. Gas, diesel, electric, hybrid etc. Default 'gas'

function.name: solarFarm__potential
function.description: Estimate the energy output of a solar farm given its location and panel area for a particular month.

coordinates.description: The geographic coordinates of the location of the solar farm.

panelArea.description: The total solar panel area in square feet at the location.

month.description: The month for which to calculate the potential energy output. Default to January

function.name: windFarm__potential
function.description: Estimate the energy output of a wind farm given its location and turbine count for a particular month.

coordinates.description: The geographic coordinates of the location of the wind farm.

turbineCount.description: The total number of wind turbines at the location.

month.description: The month for which to calculate the potential energy output. Default to January

function.name: ecological_impact__analyze
function.description: Analyzes the impact of a species on a particular ecosystem.

species.description: The species whose impact is to be calculated.

location.description: The area where the impact is analyzed.

timeframe.description: The time period for which the impact analysis should be carried out in years.

function.name: wildlife_population__assess_growth
function.description: Assesses the population growth of a specific species in a specified location over a period.

species.description: The species for which the growth is to be calculated.

location.description: The area where the species is present.

duration.description: The time period for which the population growth should be calculated in years.
